entries.5ab9db8b9fad14eb: A business not included in the reportable segments, consisting of surveying work that measures land shape and elevation and presents them in drawings, and investment operations in investment limited partnerships (LPS) and similar entities aimed at business turnaround and similar purposes. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was very small.
entries.6cffa194da18d21e: Tochi Kaoku Chōsashi Hōjin Yamada Gōdō Jimusho
entries.755e7774dc4886ea: As a debt collection company licensed by the Minister of Justice under the Act on Special Measures Concerning Debt Collection Business (the Servicer Act), this business purchases or accepts entrustment of specified monetary claims from financial institutions and other entities, and conducts valuation (due diligence), management and collection of the claims. As a sideline business, it also provides consulting on business turnaround, individual rehabilitation, business succession, business closure support, debt restructuring and similar matters, due diligence on real estate and claims, and brokerage for the sale and purchase of specified monetary claims. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥727 million.
entries.8d8c8b445ade1575: A company of the Yamada Group, centered on a claims collection company (servicer) licensed by the Minister of Justice, and also engaged in staffing and real estate solutions.
entries.ce7a9e07c0d08d5b: A business carried out by consolidated subsidiary Yamada Asset Consulting Co., Ltd., which engages in real estate sales, brokerage, leasing and consulting, among other activities. It currently focuses on business relating to land subject to leasehold rights (sōchi), providing consultation on the valuation and sale of sōchi, purchasing sōchi and selling them to leaseholders, and purchasing leasehold rights and selling them as real estate free of leasehold encumbrances. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥246 million.
entries.f0322464a3817c7a: As a sideline business approved by the Minister of Justice, this business provides worker dispatch and fee-charging employment placement. Its dispatch destinations are mainly Yamada group companies, such as Shihōshoshi Hōjin Yamada Gōdō Jimusho, Tochi Kaoku Chōsashi Hōjin Yamada Gōdō Jimusho and Yamada Escrow Trust Co., Ltd., to which it supplies personnel able to handle registration-related and inheritance-related work. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,305 million.
